coverage: 30 major central government schemes, verified active in 2026

schemes.benefit: ₹6,000 per year in 3 installments of ₹2,000
schemes.desc: Income support for landholding farmer families

eligibility.notes: Must own cultivable land in own name. Excluded: income-tax payers, serving/retired govt employees (except Group D/MTS), pensioners above ₹10,000/month, practising doctors/engineers/lawyers/CAs. eKYC and Aadhaar-seeded bank account mandatory.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)

schemes.benefit: ₹5 lakh per family per year, cashless hospitalisation
schemes.desc: Free health insurance for poor families plus all citizens aged 70+

eligibility.notes: SECC-2011 listed deprived rural households and 11 urban occupational categories (rag-picker, domestic worker, street vendor, construction worker, etc.). All Indian residents aged 70+ eligible regardless of income under Ayushman Vay Vandana card (extra ₹5 lakh top-up if family already covered). Pre-existing diseases covered from day one.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
schemes.name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना

apply.portal: udyamimitra.in / any bank, NBFC or MFI

schemes.benefit: Collateral-free loans up to ₹20 lakh
schemes.desc: Business loans for micro and small enterprises

eligibility.notes: Shishu: up to ₹50,000; Kishor: ₹50,001–₹5 lakh; Tarun: ₹5–10 lakh; Tarun Plus: ₹10–20 lakh (only for borrowers who fully repaid a Tarun loan). Non-farm micro/small enterprises incl. manufacturing, trading, services, agri-allied (dairy, poultry, beekeeping). No collateral; government guarantee via CGFMU.

schemes.name: PM Mudra Yojana (PMMY)

apply.portal: Post office or authorised bank (SBI, PNB, HDFC, ICICI, etc.)

schemes.benefit: 8.2% p.a. interest (2026), tax-free; deposits ₹250–₹1.5 lakh/year
schemes.desc: Long-term savings scheme for a girl child's education and marriage

eligibility.notes: Parent/guardian opens account for girl child below age 10. Max 2 accounts per family (exception for twins/triplets). Deposits for 15 years, maturity at 21 years. Fully tax-free (EEE). Interest rate reviewed quarterly by govt.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)

schemes.benefit: ₹1.2–1.3 lakh rural aid; up to ₹2.67 lakh urban interest subsidy
schemes.desc: Housing assistance for homeless and low-income families

eligibility.notes: PMAY-Gramin: ₹1.20 lakh (plains) / ₹1.30 lakh (hilly/NE) for rural houseless families (SECC/AwaasSoft), plus toilet/LPG/electricity convergence. PMAY-Urban 2.0 CLSS: EWS (income up to ₹3L) 6.5% subsidy, LIG (₹3–6L) 6.5%, MIG-I (₹6–12L) 4%, MIG-II (₹12–18L) 3%. Must not own a pucca house anywhere; woman ownership/co-ownership mandatory in urban.

schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana (Gramin + Urban 2.0)

schemes.benefit: Deposit-free LPG connection + free stove + first refill free; ₹300/refill subsidy
schemes.desc: Free cooking gas connection for low-income women

eligibility.notes: Adult woman from eligible poor household (SC/ST, AAY, PMAY, SECC). No existing LPG connection in any family member's name. Migrant families can apply with self-declaration instead of local ration card. ₹300 subsidy per 14.2 kg refill via DBT.

schemes.name: PM Ujjwala Yojana 2.0

apply.portal: pmvishwakarma.gov.in (register at nearest Common Service Centre)

schemes.benefit: Collateral-free loan up to ₹3 lakh at 5% + ₹15,000 toolkit + ₹500/day training stipend
schemes.desc: End-to-end support for traditional artisans and craftspeople

eligibility.notes: Artisan/craftsperson in one of 18 notified family-based traditional trades (carpenter, blacksmith, goldsmith, potter, tailor, barber, cobbler, etc.), self-employed in unorganised sector. One member per family only. Must not have taken similar credit-based govt scheme loans in past 5 years. Loan in 2 tranches: ₹1L (18 months) then ₹2L (30 months). Registration only at CSC with Aadhaar biometric.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma

schemes.benefit: Free skill training + up to ₹8,000 on certification
schemes.desc: Free short-term skill training with certification and placement help

eligibility.notes: Indian citizen; unemployed youth, school/college dropouts, informal workers. 40+ sectors incl. AI, coding, drones, EV, solar, healthcare. Short-term training (150–300 hrs); RPL track for 18–59 for existing skills. Extended till 31 December 2026. No income limit.

schemes.name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY)

apply.portal: Any bank branch / net banking / post office

schemes.benefit: Guaranteed pension ₹1,000–₹5,000/month from age 60
schemes.desc: Low-cost pension for unorganised-sector workers

eligibility.notes: Since Oct 2022, income-tax payers are NOT eligible to join. Contribution ₹42–₹1,454/month depending on entry age and pension slab (e.g. age 18: ₹210/month for ₹5,000 pension). Pension to spouse after death; corpus returned to nominee. Enrol at any bank/post office with Aadhaar-linked savings account.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)

apply.portal: Your bank / post office (branch, net banking or SMS)

schemes.benefit: ₹2 lakh life cover for ₹436/year
schemes.desc: Affordable life insurance for bank account holders

eligibility.notes: Needs savings bank/post-office account with auto-debit consent. Covers death due to any cause. Renewable yearly up to age 55. No medical test. One-year cover cycle 1 June–31 May.

schemes.name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)

apply.portal: Your bank / post office (branch, net banking or SMS)

schemes.benefit: ₹2 lakh accident cover for ₹20/year
schemes.desc: Accident death/disability insurance at near-zero cost

eligibility.notes: ₹2 lakh for accidental death/total disability; ₹1 lakh for partial disability. Auto-debited yearly from bank/post-office account. Can hold alongside PMJJBY — both together cost ₹456/year.

schemes.name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)

schemes.benefit: Full crop-loss cover; farmer pays only 2% (Kharif) / 1.5% (Rabi) / 5% (commercial) premium
schemes.desc: Crop insurance against drought, flood, pests and other calamities

eligibility.notes: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas incl. tenant farmers and sharecroppers. Govt pays the balance premium (no upper cap on subsidy). Covers prevented sowing to post-harvest losses. Voluntary for all farmers.

schemes.name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)

apply.portal: Anganwadi Centre / approved health facility / pmmvy.wcd.gov.in

schemes.benefit: ₹5,000 for first child; ₹6,000 if second child is a girl
schemes.desc: Maternity cash benefit for pregnant and lactating women

eligibility.notes: First live birth (any gender) gets ₹5,000 in 2 instalments tied to ANC visits and child immunisation; second birth gets ₹6,000 only if the child is a girl. Excludes women in regular central/state govt or PSU employment or already receiving paid maternity benefits. Husband's Aadhaar no longer mandatory (helps single mothers).

schemes.name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)

apply.portal: NFSA ration card via State Food & Civil Supplies Dept / Fair Price Shop

schemes.benefit: Free foodgrains: 5 kg/person/month (PHH) or 35 kg/family/month (AAY)
schemes.desc: Free monthly ration for 81+ crore poor families

eligibility.notes: No separate application — anyone holding an NFSA ration card (AAY or Priority Household) automatically gets the free ration at Fair Price Shops. Extended till December 2028 (merged with NFSA since Jan 2023; the extra COVID-era ration ended Dec 2022).

schemes.name: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)

schemes.benefit: ₹5,000/month stipend for 12 months + ₹6,000 one-time grant
schemes.desc: Paid 12-month internship in top companies for youth

eligibility.notes: Education: 10th/12th/ITI/diploma/general graduation. Not eligible: full-time employed or full-time students, professional degrees (B.Tech, MBA, CA, MBBS, PhD, masters), IIT/IIM graduates, family member in permanent govt job, NAPS/NATS apprentices. Insurance under PMJJBY+PMSBY included.

schemes.name: PM Internship Scheme

schemes.benefit: Up to ₹78,000 subsidy (₹30k for 1kW, ₹60k for 2kW, ₹78k for 3kW+)
schemes.desc: Rooftop solar subsidy aiming for 300 free units/month

eligibility.notes: Indian citizen owning a house with a suitable roof and a valid electricity connection; no prior solar subsidy on the property. Tenants and commercial consumers not eligible. Target: 1 crore households by March 2027.

schemes.name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
schemes.name_hi: पीएम सूर्य घर मुफ्त बिजली योजना

schemes.benefit: Bank loan ₹10 lakh–₹1 crore for greenfield enterprise
schemes.desc: Business loans for SC/ST and women first-time entrepreneurs

eligibility.notes: SC/ST or woman entrepreneur (any caste), 18+, first-time (greenfield) venture in manufacturing, services, trading or agri-allied — not expansion of an existing business. Non-individual entities need 51% SC/ST/woman shareholding. Composite loan (term + working capital), up to 7 yrs + 18-month moratorium, credit guarantee via CGFSIL. No default history.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India

schemes.benefit: 15–35% capital subsidy on new business (project up to ₹50L mfg / ₹20L service)
schemes.desc: Subsidised loans for setting up new micro enterprises

eligibility.notes: 8th pass required for projects above ₹10L (manufacturing) / ₹5L (service). New units only (upgradation track exists separately for existing PMEGP/REGP/Mudra units). Subsidy: General 15% urban / 25% rural; Special (SC/ST/OBC/women/minorities/ex-servicemen/PH) 25% urban / 35% rural. One person per family. Trading sector not eligible. Nodal agency: KVIC.

schemes.name: PM Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)

apply.portal: Local SHG / Block Development Office / lakhpatididi.gov.in

schemes.benefit: Skill training + collateral-free credit to reach ₹1 lakh+/year household income
schemes.desc: Livelihood support for women SHG members to become lakh earners

eligibility.notes: Must be an active member of a Self-Help Group under DAY-NRLM (rural). Target: 3 crore women (ambition 6 crore). SHG-linked loans of ₹1–5 lakh, convergence with Mudra/PMEGP/Stand-Up India. 2026 addition: SHE-Marts community retail outlets.

schemes.name: Lakhpati Didi Initiative

schemes.benefit: Working-capital loans ₹15,000 → ₹25,000 → ₹50,000 + 7% interest subsidy
schemes.desc: Micro-loans for street vendors with digital cashback

eligibility.notes: Street vendors identified in ULB surveys, vending before 24 March 2020, with Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation from ULB. Restructured 2025: tranches raised to ₹15k/₹25k/₹50k, extended till March 2030. 7% annual interest subsidy; cashback up to ₹1,600 on digital transactions; UPI-linked RuPay credit card (₹30,000 limit) after repaying second loan.

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi
schemes.name_hi: पीएम स्वनिधि (प्रधानमंत्री स्ट्रीट वेंडर आत्मनिर्भर निधि)

schemes.benefit: ₹3,000/month guaranteed pension from age 60
schemes.desc: Pension for unorganised-sector workers

eligibility.notes: Unorganised worker with monthly income up to ₹15,000; not enrolled in EPFO/ESIC/NPS, not an income-tax payer. Monthly contribution ₹55–₹200 (by entry age), matched 1:1 by govt. Spouse gets 50% family pension after death. Enrol at CSC or maandhan.in. 54 lakh+ enrolled as of mid-2026.

schemes.name: PM Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM)

apply.portal: Any bank branch / Bank Mitra (free account opening)

schemes.benefit: Zero-balance account + ₹2 lakh accident insurance + up to ₹10,000 overdraft
schemes.desc: Free bank account with insurance and credit for the unbanked

eligibility.notes: Any Indian resident (minors 10+ with guardian). No minimum balance. RuPay debit card with ₹2L accident insurance (use card at least once in 90 days to keep cover active). Overdraft up to ₹10,000 after 6 months of satisfactory operation (age 18–65, one per household). Gateway to PMJJBY/PMSBY/APY. 59 crore+ accounts as of Aug 2026.

schemes.name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)

apply.portal: Any bank branch / pmkisan.gov.in KCC module

schemes.benefit: Crop loans up to ₹5 lakh; effective 4% interest up to ₹3 lakh
schemes.desc: Cheap revolving credit for farmers and allied activities

eligibility.notes: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, SHG/JLG farmer groups, animal husbandry/dairy/fisheries farmers. 7% base rate with 3% prompt-repayment subvention = 4% effective up to ₹3L. Collateral-free up to ₹2L. 2025-26: crop loan limit under MISS raised from ₹3L to ₹5L.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)

apply.portal: ASHA worker / Anganwadi Centre / Govt hospital or PHC

schemes.benefit: ₹1,400 (rural) / ₹1,000 (urban) cash for institutional delivery in low-performing states
schemes.desc: Cash incentive promoting hospital deliveries for mothers

eligibility.notes: LPS (UP, Bihar, MP, Rajasthan, Odisha, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Assam, Uttarakhand, J&K): all pregnant women delivering in govt/accredited facility. HPS: BPL or SC/ST women aged 19+. Amounts: LPS rural ₹1,400 / urban ₹1,000; HPS rural ₹700 / urban ₹600. ASHA worker gets separate incentive. Paid via DBT.

schemes.name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)

schemes.benefit: ₹12,000/year (₹1,000/month) for Classes 9–12
schemes.desc: Merit scholarship to stop dropouts after Class 8

eligibility.notes: Class 8 students in govt/govt-aided/local-body schools with 55% in Class 7 (50% for SC/ST). Must clear state-level NMMS exam (MAT+SAT). Family income up to ₹3.5L/year. Not for KV/JNV/Sainik/private-unaided school students. 1 lakh fresh scholarships/year; paid via DBT.

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)

schemes.benefit: ₹12,000/year (UG years 1–3); ₹20,000/year (PG / years 4–5)
schemes.desc: Merit-cum-means scholarship for Class 12 toppers

eligibility.notes: Above 80th percentile of successful candidates in Class 12 board (stream-wise), pursuing regular UG/PG course in recognised institution. Family income up to ₹4.5L/year. 82,000 fresh scholarships/year (50% girls). Not for distance/correspondence/diploma courses or holders of other scholarships. Renewal needs 50% marks and 75% attendance.

schemes.name: Central Sector Scholarship for College & University Students (PM-USP/CSSS)

schemes.benefit: Free assistive devices (wheelchair, hearing aid, spectacles, dentures, walking aids)
schemes.desc: Free living aids for BPL senior citizens with age-related disabilities

eligibility.notes: 60+ years, BPL household or monthly income up to ₹15,000, with age-related disability/infirmity (low vision, hearing impairment, loss of teeth, locomotor disability). Not a cash pension — devices only. Distributed via ALIMCO assessment camps; 30% of beneficiaries per district are women. Elder helpline: 14567.

schemes.name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana

schemes.benefit: 35% credit-linked subsidy up to ₹10 lakh per unit
schemes.desc: Subsidy and seed capital for micro food-processing units

eligibility.notes: Individuals: existing micro food-processing unit, 8th pass, one applicant per family. Also SHGs (₹40,000/member seed capital), FPOs, cooperatives. Uses One District One Product approach. Beneficiary contributes min 10%, rest bank loan, subsidy back-ended. Originally 2020-21 to 2025-26 — confirm new applications still open before committing spend.

schemes.name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
schemes.name_hi: प्रधानमंत्री सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्यम औपचारिकीकरण योजना

schemes.benefit: Free 3–12 month placement-linked skill training (free stay/food/travel)
schemes.desc: Free residential skill training with job placement for rural youth

eligibility.notes: Rural youth from poor households (BPL). Max age extended to 45 for women, PwD and SC/ST candidates. Training partners must place at least 70% of certified candidates in formal jobs at minimum wage. DDU-GKY 2.0 batches rolling out from Oct 2026 (9 lakh targets for 2026-28).

schemes.name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY 2.0)
schemes.name_hi: दीन दयाल उपाध्याय ग्रामीण कौशल्य योजना

schemes.benefit: Free skill training + stipend ₹1,000–1,500/month
schemes.desc: Free skilling for SC/OBC/EWS/DNT youth with placement support

eligibility.notes: Target groups: SCs, OBCs, EWS, DNTs, Safai Karamcharis incl. waste pickers. No income limit for SC/DNT/Safai Karamcharis; OBC/EWS below ₹3L/year; EBC below ₹1L/year. Training types: upskilling, short-term (3 months), long-term (7 months), entrepreneurship. Stipend ₹1,500/month for SC/Safai, ₹1,000/month for OBC/EBC/DNT. 70% placement target.

schemes.name: PM-DAKSH Yojana
schemes.name_hi: पीएम-दक्ष योजना (प्रधानमंत्री दक्षता और कुशलता सम्पन्न हितग्राही)
